description: Estimate the pKa of each acidic site (the X–H, in water and in DMSO where tabulated) and the pKaH of each basic site of a structure, most acidic first, with the basis of each value. These are the same rule-based estimates as the Lone Pair editor's pKa tool: tabulated values (Evans–Ripin, Bordwell/Reich, Williams) with Hammett and inductive corrections, usually within ±1 unit for simple sites. Call this instead of searching the web for an estimate, and say the numbers are estimates. Atoms are numbered from 1 in the order the input writes them (SMILES order); `atoms` limits the answer to those atoms and also shows weak C–H acids, which are left out by default. Symmetric sites are listed once with a count. Not for drawing (use draw), formula and mass (use analyze) or bond energies (use estimate_bde).

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

atoms.description: Only these atoms (numbered from 1 in input order). Default: every site.

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Default false.

name: estimate_pka
title: Estimate pKa values
